6. (1) Stock issued under the provisions of this Ordinance
shall be issued by the Treasury upon such terms as may be
approved by the Minister and shall be authenticated either
by the signature of the Secretary to the Treasury or by
facsimile of such signature or in such manner as may be
approved by the Secretary to the Treasury.

(2) Stock issued under the provisions of this Ordinance
shall be in such form as the Secretary to the Treasury may
from time to time approve.

7. Any application to take up stock issued under this
Ordinance may be refused by the Secretary to the Treasury
without reason assigned.

8. (1) All stock issued under the provisions of this
Ordinance shall be entered in a register to be kept for the
purpose by the Treasury in such form as may from time to
time be approved by the Secretary to the Treasury.

(2) All stock issued under the provisions of this Ordinance
and the right to receive the principal moneys and interest
represented thereby shall be transferable by an instrument
of transfer registered by the Treasury.

(3) No stock issued under the provisions of this Ordinance
shall be registered except in the name of an individual person
or persons or of a corporation.

9. (1) The interest upon the principal moneys represented
by stock issued under the provisions of this Ordinance shall
be paid half-yearly at the office of the Treasury or the
Bank Negara Tanah Melayu as shall be specified in the
prospectus relating to the issue of such stock.

(2) The Minister shall in each half-yearly period ending
with the day on which interest on stock issued under the
provisions of this Ordinance falls due, appropriate out of
the / Consolidated Fund a sum equal to one half-year's
interest on the whole of the stock so issued in order that the
interest for such half-year may be paid therefrom.

PART IV
PROVISIONS RELATING TO REDEMPTION OF STOCK AND

11. Stock issued under the provisions of this Ordinance
shall be redeemable at par on such dates as may be specified
in the prospectus, after which dates all the interest on the
principal moneys represented thereby shall cease and deter-
mine, whether payment of such principal moneys shall have
been demanded or not.
